blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
The rapid expansion of large-scale medical datasets and computational resources has driven significant progress in medical foundation models. Given the inherent heterogeneity of medical imaging modalities, current research mainly follows two paths: specialized models optimized for specific modalities, and generalist models designed to handle multiple modalities. However, medical generalist models suffer from both insufficient training data
scale relative to natural image generalists and inadequate domain-specific depth
relative to medical specialists. Empirically, generalist models establish a cross-modality performance baseline, while specialists define the performance ceiling within their respective domains.
To elevate this baseline toward these ceilings, we propose Med-RADIO , a medical multi-teacher distillation framework that Reduces All Domains Into One by compressing complementary expertise from multiple domain-specific teachers into a unified medical vision foundation model. Our method curates both generalist and specialist teachers, allocates modality-aligned distillation streams to reorganize generalist pretraining data so it matches specialist domains, and uses a balanced loss to prevent any single teacher from dominating the distillation process.
On internal and external classification benchmarks spanning five modalities, Med-RADIO improves over strong medical generalists under linear probing and remains competitive with representative specialists on most evaluated modalities.
Code is available at https://github.com/CAIR-HKISI/Med-RADIO .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The rapid expansion of large-scale medical datasets and computational resources has driven significant progress in medical foundation models [ 38 ] . Given the inherent heterogeneity of medical imaging modalities, current research follows two trajectories: specialized models optimized for specific modalities such as chest X-ray, pathology, and dermatology, and generalist models designed to handle multiple modalities. However, medical generalist models face a structural weakness rooted in data scale. Compared to well-established generalists in the natural image domain such as CLIP [ 37 , 14 ] , DINOv2 [ 32 , 46 ] , and SAM [ 21 , 41 , 2 ] , they are trained on orders-of-magnitude less data (billions versus millions of images). Consequently, they fail to develop the domain-specific depth comparable to medical specialists trained on millions of modality-specific images. This data deficit restricts generalist models to a cross-modality performance baseline, while specialists define the performance ceiling within their respective domains.
blocks.zh: 大规模医疗数据集和计算资源的快速扩张,推动了医疗基础模型的显著进步 [38]. 鉴于医学成像模式的内在异质性,目前的研究遵循两种轨迹:为胸X射线,病理学,皮肤学等特定模式优化的专门模型;为处理多种模式而设计的通论模型. 然而,医学通论模型面临着根植于数据尺度的结构弱点. 相较于CLIP [37, 14], DINov2 [32, 46], SAM [21, 41, 2] 等自然图像领域的成熟通论家,他们接受了关于放大指令较少数据(亿对百万图像)的培训. 因此,它们未能开发出与接受过数百万模式特有图像培训的医学专家相类似的特定领域深度。 这种数据不足将通论模型限制在跨模式性性能基线上,而专家则在各自领域内确定性能上限.

blocks.en: This discrepancy raises a fundamental question: can we construct a unified medical vision foundation model that elevates generalist capability toward specialist performance? Several straightforward approaches prove inadequate. Ensembling [ 6 ] specialist models incurs prohibitive inference costs and yields no unified representation. Weight merging [ 42 ] is infeasible due to architectural heterogeneity across backbones. Multi-teacher knowledge distillation [ 52 ] offers a principled alternative—training a single student to integrate complementary expertise—yet applying it to medical imaging reveals three critical barriers. First, architectural heterogeneity across medical teachers produces misaligned output spaces. Second, modality heterogeneity introduces distribution sensitivity unique to healthcare: specialist teachers require modality-specific inputs to transfer domain expertise effectively. Third, optimization dynamics tend to be dominated by stronger teachers, suppressing weaker but complementary signals and causing imbalanced capability inheritance [ 40 ] .
blocks.zh: 这一差异提出了一个根本问题:我们能否构建一个统一的医疗视觉基础模型,将通论能力提升到专家的绩效? 一些直截了当的办法证明是不够的。 由[6]个专家模型构成的推论费用令人望而却步,没有统一的代表性。 重量合并[42],由于建筑跨骨干差异而难以实现. 多教师知识提炼[52]提供了一个有原则的替代办法——培训一名学生以融合互补的专门知识——将知识提炼应用于医学成像显示出三个关键的障碍。 首先,医学教师的建筑异质性产生错位输出空间. 第二,模式异质性引入了保健特有的分配敏感性:专业教师需要模式特定的投入来有效转让领域专门知识。 第三,优化动态往往以更强的教师为主,压制更弱但互补的信号并造成能力继承不平衡[40].

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose Med-RADIO , a medical multi-teacher distillation framework that Reduces All Domains Into One by compressing complementary expertise from multiple domain-specific teachers into a unified medical vision foundation model. Our key insight is data leverage: by repartitioning the generalist pretraining corpus into modality-specific streams, we indirectly access the distributed expertise of specialists—collectively exposed to tens of millions of domain-specific images—without retrieving original specialist corpora. By freezing all teachers and training only the student encoder with lightweight projectors, we decouple data scale from computational cost, achieving specialist-approaching depth at generalist-scale expense.
blocks.zh: 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议采用医疗-RADIO这一医疗多教师提炼框架,将所有领域都缩小到 一是将多个域特有教师的补充专业知识压缩为统一的医学视野基础模型. 我们的关键洞察力是数据杠杆:通过将一般专家预训书重新分为模式特定流,我们间接地获得专家的分布性专门知识——集体暴露在数千万个领域特定图像中——而不检索原始专家公司。 通过冻结所有教师和只培训使用轻量级投影仪的学生编码器,我们把数据尺度从计算成本中解开,实现专家处理深度,以一般化规模成本为代价.

blocks.en: Our methodology rests on three innovations. (1) Teacher curation with modality-specific projectors: we systematically select complementary teachers and introduce domain-specific MLP projectors to align heterogeneous output spaces. (2) Modality-aligned distillation streams: we reorganize the pretraining corpus of UniMed-CLIP [ 19 ] into single-modality subsets, ensuring each specialist receives data drawn from its native distribution. (3) Balanced distillation loss: we employ a contribution-aware weighting scheme that prevents dominant teachers from suppressing complementary signals; UniMed-CLIP further serves as a mandatory generalist anchor, preserving cross-modal stability.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法基于三个创新。 (1) 教师用特定模式的投影仪进行校正:我们系统地选择补充教师,并采用特定领域MLP投影仪,以调整不同产出空间。 (2) 模式相接的蒸馏流:我们把UniMed-CLIP[19]的预训集重组为单一模式子集,确保每位专家都能收到其本地分布数据。 (3)平衡蒸馏损失:我们采用一种认识到贡献的加权办法,防止占支配地位的教师压制互补信号;UniMed-CLIP进一步充当强制性通俗主义锚地,维护跨模式稳定性.

blocks.en: We validate Med-RADIO through extensive experiments on internal and external classification benchmarks spanning five medical imaging modalities. Our unified encoder consistently improves over strong generalist baselines and remains competitive with dedicated specialists on most modalities, demonstrating that strategic distillation enables unified breadth and depth without proportional resource investment. By elevating generalist capability toward specialist performance, Med-RADIO offers a practical path for deploying single, versatile models across heterogeneous medical imaging workflows.
blocks.zh: 我们通过对涉及五种医学成像模式的内部和外部分类基准进行广泛实验,验证了医疗-雷达信息。 我们的统一编码器在强而有力的通用基线上不断改进,在多数模式上仍然与专职专家有竞争力,表明战略分解能够实现统一广度和深度,而无需按比例的资源投资。 通过将通论能力提升到专家工作水平,医疗-无线电通信组织为在各种医疗成像工作流程中部署单一的多功能模型提供了一个切实可行的途径。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Medical Vision Foundation Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 医疗展望基金会模式

blocks.en: Large-scale medical vision foundation models have proliferated across radiology, pathology, and multimodal imaging. Early efforts concentrated on modality-specific pretraining, yielding specialized architectures for ultrasound [ 17 , 16 , 53 ] , MRI [ 5 , 1 ] , CT [ 33 , 10 , 4 ] , chest X-ray [ 35 , 51 ] , fundus photography [ 55 , 44 , 45 , 36 ] , histopathology [ 3 , 28 , 13 ] , and dermatology [ 49 , 20 ] . These specialist models leverage modality-tailored architectures and inductive biases to establish strong performance ceilings within their respective domains.
blocks.zh: 大规模医疗视觉基础模型在放射学、病理学和多模式成像中扩散。 早期工作集中在模式特定的预训上,产生了超声波[17,16,53],核磁共振[5,1],CT[33,10,4],胸X射线[35,51],基金摄影[55,44,45,36],组织病理学[3,28,13],皮肤学[49,20]等专业架构. 这些专家模式利用适合模式的架构和诱导性偏见,在各自领域建立强有力的业绩上限。

blocks.en: Concurrently, generalist medical vision models aim to acquire cross-modality representations from large-scale heterogeneous corpora, including vision-language alignment models such as BioMedCLIP [ 54 ] , PubMedCLIP [ 8 ] , PMC-CLIP [ 24 ] , BMCA-CLIP [ 27 ] , and UniMed-CLIP [ 19 ] , as well as unified multi-modality encoders such as Uni-Med [ 56 ] , Lingshu [ 48 ] , and Hulu-Med [ 15 ] . However, these models confront a fundamental structural deficit: relative to natural image foundation models trained on billions of images, medical generalists rely on corpora typically comprising only millions of images. This data gap causes generalist models to consistently underperform modality-specific experts on single-modality benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 同时,通式医学视觉模型旨在从大型异形公司获得跨模式表示,包括视觉语言对接模型,如BioMedCLIP [54],PubMedCLIP [8],PMC-CLIP [24],BMCA-CLIP [27],和UniMed-CLIP [19],以及Uni-Med [56],Lingshu [48],Hulu-Med [15]等统一的多模式编码. 然而,这些模型面临一个根本的结构缺陷:相对于接受过数十亿图像训练的自然图像基础模型,医学通论者通常只依赖由数百万图像组成的公司. 这一数据差距导致通用模型在单一模式基准方面始终未能使具体模式专家得到良好表现。

blocks.en: Recent attempts to close this gap via model ensemble [ 29 ] or weight merging [ 50 ] encounter fundamental practical barriers: ensemble methods incur multiplicative inference costs incompatible with clinical workflows, while architectural heterogeneity across backbones precludes direct parameter fusion. These limitations motivate distillation-based approaches as a principled alternative.
blocks.zh: 最近试图通过模型聚合[29]或重量合并[50]来弥合这一差距,遇到了基本的实际障碍:集合方法产生与临床工作流程相矛盾的多语言推论成本,而跨骨干结构的异质性排除了直接参数聚合. 这些限制促使采用以蒸馏为基础的方法作为原则性替代办法。

blocks.en: 2.2 Distilling Foundation Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 稀释基金会模式

blocks.en: Knowledge distillation [ 52 ] has recently evolved from model compression toward distillation among foundation models themselves. AM-RADIO [ 39 ] and RADIOv2.5 [ 11 ] pioneered multi-teacher distillation in natural images, unifying heterogeneous encoders including SAM, CLIP, and DINOv2 into a single versatile backbone. However, these works operate on homogeneous photographic data, circumventing the modality divergence and optimization imbalance intrinsic to medical imaging.
blocks.zh: 知识分馏[52]最近从模型压缩发展到基础模型本身之间的分馏. AM-RADIO [39]和RADIOv2.5 [11]率先在自然图像中进行多教师蒸馏,将包括SAM,CLIP,和DINov2在内的多功能编码器统一为单一的主干. 然而,这些作品以同质相片数据为基础,避免了医学成像所固有的模式差异和优化不平衡.

blocks.en: In the medical domain, distillation remains limited in scope: existing efforts distill from single teachers [ 34 , 9 ] , operate within identical architectures [ 47 ] , or restrict transfer to a single modality [ 30 ] . Med-RADIO instead targets multi-teacher distillation across heterogeneous medical foundation models, jointly addressing architectural misalignment, optimization imbalance, and modality distribution sensitivity.
blocks.zh: 在医疗领域,蒸馏的范围仍然有限:单师的现有努力蒸馏[34,9],在相同的架构内运作[47],或将转让限制为单一方式[30]. Med-RADIO则针对不同医学基础模型的多教师蒸馏,共同解决建筑结构错位问题,优化不平衡,以及模式分配敏感性.

blocks.en: 2.3 Multi-Teacher Knowledge Distillation
blocks.zh: 2.3 多教师知识分解

blocks.en: Multi-teacher knowledge distillation (MKD) aggregates complementary supervisory signals from diverse experts [ 52 ] . Representation space alignment is critical: directly enforcing feature consistency between structurally dissimilar teachers and students imposes overly rigid constraints [ 26 ] . Early uniform weighting schemes treat all teachers equally, risking performance collapse or teacher dominance. Adaptive mechanisms have been proposed to mitigate these issues, including uncertainty-aware weighting [ 18 ] , auxiliary loss-based aggregation [ 12 ] , and gradient-balanced adaptive weights [ 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 多教师知识分馏(MKD)汇集了来自不同专家的补充监督信号[52]. 表现空间的调整至关重要:直接执行结构相异的师生之间的特征一致性,造成过于僵硬的限制[26]. 早期的统一加权办法平等对待所有教师,有可能造成绩效崩溃或教师占主导地位。 为缓解这些问题,提出了适应机制,包括不确定性意识权重[18]、基于损失的辅助权重[12]和梯度平衡权重[25]。

blocks.en: Medical imaging exacerbates these challenges: diverse backbones (ViT variants, Swin Transformers) produce severely misaligned output spaces; heterogeneous pretraining scales cause dominant specialists to suppress complementary generalists; and modality distribution sensitivity requires preserving specialized inductive biases under native data exposure. Med-RADIO addresses these issues with modality-specific projection heads, a contribution-aware balanced loss, and modality-aligned data streams.
blocks.zh: 医学成像加剧了这些挑战:不同的骨干(ViT变体,Swin Transformers)产生严重错位的输出空间;不同的预训尺度导致占优势的专家压制互补通论者;模式分布敏感性要求在本土数据曝光下保留专门的导出偏差. Med-RADIO用特定模式的投影头、对贡献的认识平衡的损失以及模式相通的数据流来解决这些问题。

blocks.en: 3.1 Framework Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 框架概览

blocks.en: Our objective is to develop a unified medical vision foundation model that synergistically integrates cross-modality generalization capabilities from a generalist teacher with fine-grained, modality-specific expertise from multiple specialist teachers. To achieve this, we propose a multi-teacher distillation framework comprising three interconnected components: (1) a heterogeneous ensemble of pre-trained teacher models, (2) modality-specific translator heads for cross-architecture feature alignment, and (3) a balanced distillation objective.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是开发一个统一的医学视野基础模型,协同结合一位通才教师的跨模式通才能力,多位专业教师具有精细的,模式特有的专业知识. 为此,我们提出由三个相互关联的组成部分组成的多教师蒸馏框架:(1) 预先培训的教师模型的多样组合;(2) 跨建筑特征组合的特定模式翻译头;(3) 平衡的蒸馏目标。

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Fig. 2 , the training pipeline operates through multiple concurrent data streams: each specialist teacher supervises samples from its dedicated modality, while the generalist teacher processes the entire heterogeneous corpus to provide cross-domain regularization. The unified student encoder, shared across all streams, aggregates complementary knowledge through the balanced distillation objective (Eq. 5 ).
This design lets the student inherit both broad transferable representations and precise domain-specific inductive biases.
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,培训渠道通过多个并行数据流运作:每个专业教师都从其专用模式监督样本,而普通教师则处理整个多样性单元,以提供跨领域正规化。 统一的学生编码器通过平衡分馏目标(Eq. 5.),在所有流流中共享,集成互补知识.
这种设计让学生既继承了广泛的可转移表述,又继承了精确的域特有引导偏差.

blocks.en: 3.2 Pretraining Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 预训数据集建设

blocks.en: A naive approach to multi-teacher distillation would require curating separate, large-scale pretraining datasets for each specialist teacher, a prohibitively expensive endeavor given the scarcity of annotated medical data. We circumvent this bottleneck through a modality-decoupled data reconstruction strategy: rather than assembling new datasets, we repartition the existing pretraining corpus of UniMed-CLIP into exclusive single-modality subsets, each serving as a dedicated distillation stream for the corresponding specialist teacher. This design enables the generalist teacher to maintain cross-modal alignment on the complete heterogeneous mixture, while each specialist receives purified, modality-focused supervision, without any additional data collection or annotation effort.
blocks.zh: 多教师蒸馏的天真方法需要为每位专家教师分别提供大规模预训数据集,鉴于缺乏附加说明的医疗数据,这项工作费用高昂。 我们通过一种模式脱钩的数据重建战略来规避这一瓶颈:我们不是收集新的数据集,而是将现有的UniMed-CLIP预训集重新划分为独有的单一模式子集,每个集作为相应的专业教师的专用蒸馏流. 这种设计使通才教师能够保持完全多样化的混合物的跨模式协调,而每个专家则接受纯洁的、注重模式的监督,而无需进行任何额外的数据收集或注释工作。

blocks.en: The pretraining data of UniMed-CLIP is composed of subsets encompassing seven major medical imaging modalities: X-ray, computed tomography (CT), magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), ultrasound (US), histopathology whole-slide images (WSI), dermatology photography and Fundus. To support the multi-teacher distillation, we derive five single-modality subsets (US, MRI, CT, histopathology, and dermatology) from this corpus, alongside one multimodal mixture drawn from heterogeneous sources such as PMC-OA [ 24 ] , ROCOv2 [ 43 ] , and LLaVA-Med [ 23 ] . Detailed dataset curation procedures and modality-wise statistics are provided in the Supplementary Material.
blocks.zh: UniMed-CLIP的预训数据由包含七个主要医学成像模式的子集组成: X-射线、计算成型成像(CT)、磁共振成像(MRI)、超声波(美国)、组织病理学全滑行图像(WSI)、皮肤学摄影和Fundus。 为了支持多教师蒸馏,我们从这种血清中提取出五个单一模式子集(美国、核磁共振、CT、组织病理学和皮肤病理学),同时从多种来源,如PMC-OA[24]、ROCOv2[43]和LLaVA-Med[23]中抽取一种多模式混合物。 《补充材料》提供了详细的数据集管理程序和按方式统计。

blocks.en:
We assess representational quality under two protocols:
1) linear probing: the pre-trained encoder is strictly frozen; only a linear head trained on top of the extracted global CLS token is optimized for 50 epochs with AdamW (peak learning rate 1 × 10 − 3 1\times 10^{-3} , cosine schedule, batch size 256), directly probing the linearly separable structure of the pre-trained representations.
2) full fine-tuning: all encoder parameters are jointly optimized end-to-end with a task-specific head for 50 epochs (peak LR 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} , cosine schedule, batch size 64), providing an upper-bound assessment of adaptation capacity.
blocks.zh:
我们根据两项议定书评估代表的质量:
1) 线性探险:被预先训练的编码器被严格地冻结;只有被提取出的全球CLS令牌上方所训练的线性头被优化为有AdamW的50个时代(峰值学习率1×10−3 1\times 10×3},相声表,批量大小256),直接验证被预先训练的表示物的线性分离结构.
2)全细调出:所有编码器参数由50个时段(峰值LR 5× 10− 5\times 10× 5},接力排程,批量尺寸64)的任务专用头来联合优化端到端,提供适应能力的上限评估.

blocks.en:
Our primary ( internal ) evaluation spans nine classification benchmarks across five modalities: two ultrasound datasets (Thyroid-US and Breast-US), two MRI datasets (ACL Tear and Meniscus Tear), three CT datasets (MediMeTA Axial, Coronal, and Sagittal), one histopathology dataset (PCam), and one dermatology dataset (HAM). Following domain conventions, we report AUC for ultrasound/MRI and ACC for CT, histopathology, and dermatology.
To assess generalization beyond this internal suite, we additionally evaluate on an external five-modality classification protocol adapted from MMKD-CLIP [ 47 ] (Tab. 2 ).
Further details on the internal datasets are provided in the Supplementary Material.

我们的初级(内部)评价跨越9个分类基准,涵盖5种模式:2个超声波数据集(Thyroid-US和Mreast-US)、2个核磁共振数据集(ACL Tear和Meniscus Tear)、3个CT数据集(MediMeTA Axial、Coronal和Sagital)、1个组织病理学数据集(PCam)和1个皮肤学数据集(HAM)。 根据域公约,我们报告超声波/MRI的AUC和CT、组织病理学和皮肤学的ACC。
为了评估超出这一内部套件的通用性,我们进一步评价了根据MMKD-CLIP[47](第2段)改编的外部五种模式分类协议。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Limitation
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
Our results support an affirmative answer to the motivating question: a single student encoder can elevate medical generalist baselines toward specialist ceilings without ensembling models or merging incompatible weights.
Under linear probing, Med-RADIO reaches 85.28% mean AUC/ACC ( +3.38 pp over UniMed-CLIP large), remains competitive with dedicated specialists on four of five modalities, and outperforms both a medical MTKD baseline and matched balancing alternatives on the internal/external protocol.
Taken together, these findings indicate that the breadth–depth dilemma is amenable to data leverage: by repartitioning an existing generalist corpus into modality-aligned streams and distilling frozen heterogeneous teachers through lightweight translators, specialist priors can be absorbed at generalist-scale training cost and deployed in a single forward pass.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果支持对激励性问题的肯定答案:一个学生编码器可以将医学通论基线提升到专家的上限,而不采用综艺模型或合并不相容的重量。
在线性测试中,医疗-辐射防护组织达到85.28%的AUC/ACC(比UniMed-CLIP大出3.38页),在五种模式中,在四种模式上仍然与专职专家有竞争力,而且表现优于医疗MTKD基线和内部/外部协议上的匹配平衡替代品。
综合这些调查结果表明,深度的两难境地容易被数据利用:通过将现有的通论体重新划分为模式相通流,并通过轻量级翻译来提炼被冻结的多样化教师,专家前科可以按通论规模的训练费用吸收,并部署在单一的前行。

blocks.en:
Several practical takeaways emerge from the ablations and baseline comparisons.
A mandatory generalist teacher is not redundant with specialists: removing it degrades average performance by − - 1.74 pp and hits ultrasound/CT hardest, consistent with a cross-modal regularizer that stabilizes domains where specialist coverage alone is insufficient.
Contribution-aware balancing is likewise essential: unweighted multi-teacher optimization is vulnerable to dispersion extremes (low-dispersion teachers such as URFM being drowned out; high-dispersion teachers such as Curia/GPFM dominating), and generic adaptive schemes (Uncertainty, AdaLoss) underperform our angular-dispersion weighting under an otherwise identical recipe.
Finally, standard medical MTKD without modality-native teacher assignment (e.g., MMKD-CLIP) lags most clearly on ultrasound and CT, reinforcing that architectural alignment alone does not substitute for distribution-matched supervision.
blocks.zh:
从模拟和基线比较中出现了一些实际的外卖。
一个必修的通才教师与专家并非多余:去掉通才会降低平均性能--1.74页,并最猛地击中超声波/CT,这与一种跨模式的调节器相一致,它稳定了单专家覆盖面不足的领域。
贡献-认识平衡同样至关重要:未加权的多教师优化容易被分散到极端(低分散的教师,如URFM被淹死;高分散的教师,如Curia/GPFM占据主导地位)和通用适应计划(不确定性,AdaLoss)在本来完全相同的食谱下使我们的角-分散分量不足。
最后,标准的MTKD没有模式-内设教师任务(如MMKD-CLIP)最明显地落后于超声波和CT,强化了仅靠建筑配合并不能取代配给匹配的监管.

blocks.en:
Nonetheless, important limitations remain.
(i) Histopathology stream quality.
The largest specialist gap appears on histopathology, which we attribute primarily to a data-quality mismatch:
GPFM is pretrained on curated pathology corpora, whereas our histopathology distillation stream comes from Quilt-1M [ 13 ] , a noisier YouTube-collected collection.
Closing this gap likely requires higher-quality, distribution-matched pathology data (and optionally multi-scale supervision), beyond global CLS distillation alone.
(ii) Coverage.
Our evaluation focuses on 2D classification over five modalities; chest X-ray, fundus, volumetric 3D understanding, dense prediction, and VQA are not yet systematically assessed.
(iii) Teacher- and protocol-dependence.
Student quality remains bounded by the frozen teacher pool and public stream corpora, and our objective emphasizes CLS angular matching under frozen linear probing, which under-emphasizes fine-grained texture cues (e.g., Meniscus, PCam).
External hold-outs mitigate but do not remove this coupling; clinical claims should therefore be read as inference-efficient unification pending broader validation.
blocks.zh:
尽管如此,仍然存在重要的限制。
(一) 病理学流质量。
最大的专家差距出现在组织病理学上,我们主要将它归因于数据质量的不匹配:
GPFM接受过治疗性病理的预训, 而我们的组织病理蒸馏流来自Quilt-1M [13],
缩小这一差距可能需要质量更高、分布相称的病理数据(以及可选的多尺度监督),而不只是全球CLS蒸馏。
(二) 覆盖范围。
我们的评价侧重于对5种模式的2D分类;胸部X光、Fundus、体积3D理解、密集预测和VQA尚未进行系统评估。
(三) 教师和礼宾的依赖。
学生素质仍然以被冻结的教师池和公流的corpora为界,我们的目标强调CLS角匹配在被冻结的线性检测下,它低估了被精细纹理提示(如Meniscus,PCam).
外部的阻断可以减轻,但不能消除这种结合;因此,在更广泛的验证之前,临床索赔应被理解为具有推论效率的统一。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Med-RADIO , a multi-teacher distillation framework that compresses a cross-modal generalist and modality-specific specialists into one vision encoder via translator heads, modality-aligned data streams, and contribution-aware balanced loss.
Trained on a restructured 4.5M-image corpus without new specialist corpora, it achieves 85.28% mean linear-probing AUC/ACC ( +3.38 pp over the strongest generalist) and matches or surpasses dedicated specialists on four of five modalities in a single forward pass.
These results show that principled heterogeneous distillation offers a practical alternative to ensembles and weight merging for unifying medical vision foundations.
Future work will extend Med-RADIO to additional modalities, volumetric inputs, and multi-scale pathology supervision.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了Med-RADIO, 一个多教师蒸馏框架, 通过翻译头、模式相通数据流和贡献感平衡损失, 将跨模式通用和模式特定专家压缩成一个视觉编码器。
在没有新的专家团队的情况下,对经过重组的4.5M-形象仪进行了培训,实现了85.28%的线性测试AUC/ACC(+3.38页,优于最强通论者),并在单一前行的五个方式中四个方式上匹配或超过专职专家。
这些结果表明,原则性的多样性蒸馏为统一医疗愿景基础提供了一种实际的替代组合和体重合并方法。
今后的工作将扩大医疗-雷达信息网络,使之包括其他模式、体积投入和多规模病理学监督。

blocks.en: Teacher Feature Statistics Computation
blocks.zh: 教师特征统计计算

blocks.en:
The statistics expose two opposing failure modes. On one end, URFM (ultrasound, Disp = 0.003 \mathrm{Disp}{=}0.003 ) and PanDerm (dermatology, 0.127 0.127 ) encode highly concentrated feature spaces: their raw angular losses are negligibly small relative to other streams and would be entirely suppressed in unweighted multi-teacher distillation. The dispersion denominator amplifies these signals by factors of up to 333 × 333\times , ensuring the student receives meaningful ultrasound and dermatology gradients. On the other end, Curia on CT ( 1.264 1.264 ) and GPFM on histopathology ( 0.807 0.807 ) produce large raw angular losses due to high feature spread, which would otherwise dominate the joint objective and force all other teachers’ signals to zero. Dividing by these large dispersion values proportionally attenuates their contribution, preventing CT-driven optimization collapse.
This dual correction is empirically validated by the balanced KD loss ablation (Fig. 5 (c)): without it, CT Coronal ACC drops by − 15.05 -15.05 pp, and ultrasound Thyroid AUC collapses by − 14.39 -14.39 pp. This pattern aligns with Curia CT dominance while URFM is suppressed.
